items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: I remember that on St. Louis Blues he played the four or five choruses that Louis plays on St. Louis Blues.

ctx.x: Do you remember any other little things like that that Bunk played that were outstanding that didn't come through the records?

I can't think of any that... Actually, most of the tunes he played to Stuyvesant were recorded eventually. I remember that on St. Louis Blues he played the four or five choruses that Louis plays on St. Louis Blues. Let's see.
Another thing I'd like to know is who came to the Stuyvesant?
